provenance.device: Sennheiser EW-DX EM 4 Dante (EWDX4CHDS, hardware revision 0596716-09)
provenance.versionNote: the receiver's own GET /api/firmware/update/state deviceVersion; SSC protocol 2.4
provenance.recordedBy: a hand run from the dev machine (the recorder is not kept: ten requests, made with Python urllib)
method: Authenticated requests against channel 0, which had a pack linked and was in nobody's show.
The channel was read, muted, read, muted again, unmuted and read; then two things it should refuse were tried (a channel the receiver does not have, and a mute that is not a boolean).
The original state (unmuted) was written back last and read to confirm it.
note: What this establishes: the body is exactly {"mute": <boolean>}; a write answers 200 with no body; the state is read back from GET /api/channel/{n} as "mute"; writing the state a channel is already in is not an error;
and a receiver answers 400 — not 404 — to a channel it does not have and to a mute that is not a boolean. The unmuted state was restored and read back.
